main_text.p: causa, an impubes qui sine tutoris authoritate centum stipulanti spopódit, in iudiciū vocari posit: facile personæ & iudicij ratione perspecta, respondebitur non posse. E-iusdem modi graduum co-gnationis disciplina est: nec fortasse dilucidius exemplū facilè aliquis afferre posit. nam si primò TITIUM, id est eū de cuius cognatione quæritur constituamus, dein filiū infrà, suprà uero patrem appingamus, gradum unum efficiemus: tum si nepotem infrà, auum suprà, fratré uero à latere adiungamus, duos gradus habebimus: atq; ita dein-

page.notes: The running head is printed "IVRISCONSVLTVS." and has been corrected to IURISCONSULTUS. under the u/v rule. The paragraph break before "nam si" is uncertain because the line ends near the margin; the passage is kept as one paragraph. "spopódit" is copied as printed and may be a misprint for spopondit. The "m" abbreviation in "iudiciū" is read from a mark over the u.
